current_task_corrections.correction: In the feature_set component, remove billed_amount and allowed_amount from params.features. Retain only submission-time features: claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, service_units, length_of_stay, er_flag, elective_flag, preventive_flag, auth_required_flag, primary_icd10_cm, drg_present.
In the write_report component, add model_limitations to params.caveats. Update the list from ["no_operational_use"] to ["no_operational_use", "model_limitations"].

reusable_lessons.lesson: When building predictive models designed to score claims at submission time, exclude all financial amount fields (billed_amount, allowed_amount, paid_amount, member_oop, cob_amount) and derived indicators (high_cost_flag), using only features known when the claim enters the system. This prevents target leakage and ensures operational deployability.
Include the model_limitations caveat in reports documenting predictive models to communicate baseline assumptions, known constraints, and appropriate use boundaries to stakeholders.
